name: com.one80rx/treatments
title: One80Rx Treatments
description: Read-only One80Rx treatment facts for AI agents. Not medical advice.

tools.name: list_treatments
tools.description: List public One80Rx treatments using generic names. Each entry says what the medication or protocol is and points at its public source page. No prices, brand names, or promised results. A licensed provider decides whether any treatment is appropriate. Read-only. Collects nothing.

tools.name: get_treatment
tools.description: Get one public One80Rx treatment by slug from list_treatments. Describes what it is, how a request moves through assessment and provider review, and the safety notes published on the source page. Read-only. Collects nothing.

tools.name: how_it_works
tools.description: Describe the public One80Rx process: an online assessment, a decision by an independent licensed provider, and pharmacy fulfillment only if that provider authorizes treatment. Includes the age minimum and that One80Rx operates in all 50 US states. Read-only.

tools.name: get_faqs
tools.description: Return frequently asked questions copied from public One80Rx treatment pages and from FAQPage structured data on One80Rx Learn. Every item includes its source URL. Read-only. Not medical advice.

tools.name: list_resources
tools.description: List educational guides published on learn.one80rx.com. Guides are general information. A guide is not an offer of treatment. Read-only.

tools.name: eligibility_prescreen
tools.description: Non-clinical check of two fields only: age as a whole number, and a two-letter USPS code. Under 18, the public terms say the platform cannot be used. At 18 or older, each of the 50 states returns available. DC and US territories return complete intake to confirm availability. Source: confirmed by One80Rx owner, Nov 27, 2026. Rejects symptoms, names, and any other field. Stores nothing.

tools.name: get_intake_link
tools.description: Return https://one80rx.com/eligibility. Adds ?protocol= only for semaglutide, tirzepatide, glp-1-microdose, or trt_glp1_oral. Any other value is rejected and is not added to the URL. Read-only.
